data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2021 gross claims outstanding were GBP 36.46m. During the 2021 calendar year there was a modest prior-year net favourable reassessment of reserves amounting to GBP 1.983m (net), representing an approximate 5.4% release relative to opening gross reserves. The movement is described as a reassessment of net claims for previous accident years (favourable/back-year reserve releases). The syndicate remains focused on US and international property catastrophe reinsurance, with 2021 loss activity driven by multiple natural catastrophe events (e.g. Hurricane Ida, Winter Storm Uri, European floods, Kentucky Tornadoes) while prior-year reserve movements were mainly due to favourable claims development and back-year reserve releases; gross prior-year movement by line is not separately disclosed in the report.

data.data_quality_notes: No gross-figure movement for 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' was explicitly provided. The report explicitly states a net prior-year favourable reassessment of GBP 1.983k; per extraction rules this NET figure was used as a fallback. A gross prior-year movement was not located; the claims development triangle (gross) is present and has been supplied, but extracting a single authoritative gross prior-year development from that triangle was not unambiguously possible given presentation; therefore the prior_year_development_gbp_m is NET of reinsurance and may understate or differ from any undisclosed gross movement.
